sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a scheme aimed at providing financial support to small businesses and entrepreneurs.
The scheme was launched to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals.
The objective is to provide loans to micro and small enterprises to help them grow and sustain their operations.
The benefits include access to loans up to 10 lakh INR without the need for collateral.
Assistance is provided in the form of three categories of loans: Shishu for up to 50,000 INR, Kishore for 50,001 to 5 lakh INR, and Tarun for 5,00,001 to 10 lakh INR.
Eligibility includes individuals who are starting a new business or expanding an existing one.
The application process involves approaching a bank or financial institution that is a part of the PMMY scheme.
Applicants must submit necessary documents including identity proof, address proof, and business plan.
The timeline for loan disbursal varies by institution but is generally processed within a few weeks.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Finance through various banks and financial institutions.
The PMMY also aims to enhance the availability of credit to small businesses and contribute to the overall economic development of the country.
